title: How to initial the weights in the training of KD stage2?
body: How to fill the arguments when call the command caffe MLIC build tools caffe train solver weights gpu 0 image https user images githubusercontent com 7899459 49705991 bd20c680 fc5d 11e8 9772 f22ad75aff29 png I try initializing the weights using the following argument Is that right weights kd stage1 modesl iter 400000 caffemodel pretrain VGG ILSVRC 16 layers caffemodel

comments.body: weights WSDDN caffemodel layer names are modified kd stage1 modesl iter 400000 caffemodel Check last issue make sure the layer names of T WDet model have been modified

The size of kd stage1 modesl iter 400000 caffemodel is almost the twice of WSDDN caffemodel because it contains both detection and classify network The detection network is exactly the same as WSDDN caffemodel including the same layer name If reloading WSDDN caffemodel first then the weight of detection network of kd stage1 modesl iter 400000 caffemodel will overwrite WSDDN caffemodel So the arguments should be shown as follwing which means reloading kd stage1 first weights kd stage1 modesl iter 400000 caffemodel WSDDN caffemodel layer names are modified

The initial loss image https user images githubusercontent com 7899459 49788357 196e0e00 fd64 11e8 8369 26f4d9e6663d png The loss after 38000 iter with batchsize 3 image https user images githubusercontent com 7899459 49788416 47535280 fd64 11e8 8805 971848aa39d3 png
Please check that the weight of T WDet in stage1 is frozen So actually the reloading result should be indifferent from the order of the arguments in weights
Actually the pretrian model that training of stage2 needs is only stage1 model Is that right
No please check that there are two classifiers fc wsd 8 c and fc wsd 8 d in T WDet in the prototxt of s2

title: WSD loss doesn't decrease
body: solver net wsddn wsddn train prototxt test iter 800 test interval 2400 base lr 0 0001 momentum 0 9 type SGD weight decay 0 0005 lr policy inv gamma 0 00001 power 0 75 display 200 max iter 800000 snapshot 50000 snapshot prefix models solver mode GPU train batch size 3 When iteration comes to 30000 Loss varies between 20 and 50 Have you encounter the problem

comments.body: No Did you finetune with ImageNet pretrained model If so you can try to decrease the learning rate We use base lr 0 00005 to train WSDDN

Yes I finetune with the pretrian model The difference between 0 00005 and 0 0001 seems really tiny The scores of all 500 proposals are 1 Does batch size result in the problem I have tried moving your custom code to this multi gpu caffe project https github com sciencefans CaffeMex v2 But it still works in single GPU Now it comes to 90000 iteration which means the third epoch The minimum of loss is 12 The maximum is 70 But it still mainly varies between 20 and 50 WSDDN seems really hard to reproduce

I think it may not be caused by the batch size If all the scores are 1 you can set score scale as 1 and score bias as 0 in prototxt Please make sure you have modified the prototxt according to your dataset classes 80 yours boxes number 500 yours and you have checked the datalist finetuning process carefully You can set a small lr rate as 1e 5 As a reference for you the initial loss for WSDDN in our experiments is always less than 10 and it converges quickly even with batch size 1 I also have no experience on multi gpu Caffe sorry to have no idea for this issue
Please show your datalist with a screenshot solver and prototxt and tell me how you preprocess the images and how you acquire the bounding boxes I will try my best to find the issue
It seems no issues Please set the score scale as 1 and score bias as 0 and try smaller lr rate like 1e 6 and 1e 7
Search in the prototxt you will find them
The training is blocked at iter 23000 for 2 hours It has been stopped by ctrl c What may cause this problem image file Or others

Our best test loss is 3 98 We train WSDDN for 120 epochs If you didn t use the Caffe MLIC it may be caused by the Caffe you used Otherwise it may be caused by image file gpu or server You can training without shuffle data and check whether the bug would be reproduced stably at a fixed iteration If so you could locate the image file according to this iteration

Now iteration comes to 110000 which means the 4th epoch and the loss of test varies between 5 5 and 6 Is that right If not how to decrease The reason of being blocked may be the insufficient of PC memory

Sorry we can not judge whether your test loss is right because the setting you use is not consistent with ours We can only suggest you train for more epochs and possibly try other lr rate strategies like multi step
